items.title: RelaxQAT: Continuous Relaxation for Quantization-Aware Training
items.summary: Low-bit quantization presents significant challenges due to limited levels and flat loss surfaces. To address this, researchers propose RelaxQAT, a continuous relaxation method that dynamically alters the bitwidth during model training. Experiments demonstrate up to 6.3% accuracy gains on vision tasks and up to 7.7% on natural language tasks compared to leading QAT methods.
keyPoints: Introduces RelaxQAT for continuous bitwidth alteration during training.
Addresses flat quantization loss surfaces and low-bit challenges.
Achieves up to 6.3% vision and 7.7% NLP accuracy gains.

en.title: RelaxQAT: Continuous Relaxation for Quantization-Aware Training
en.summary: Low-bit quantization presents significant challenges due to limited levels and flat loss surfaces. To address this, researchers propose RelaxQAT, a continuous relaxation method that dynamically alters the bitwidth during model training. keyPoints: Introduces RelaxQAT for continuous bitwidth alteration during training.
Addresses flat quantization loss surfaces and low-bit challenges.
Achieves up to 6.3% vision and 7.7% NLP accuracy gains.

fr.title: RelaxQAT : Relaxation continue pour l'entraînement conscient de la quantification
fr.summary: La quantification à faible nombre de bits pose des problèmes majeurs en raison de surfaces de perte plates. Les chercheurs proposent RelaxQAT, une méthode de relaxation continue qui modifie progressivement la largeur de bits pendant l'entraînement. Les expériences montrent des gains de précision allant jusqu'à 6,3 % en vision et 7,7 % en traitement du langage.
keyPoints: Présente RelaxQAT pour modifier continuellement la largeur de bits.
Résout les difficultés liées aux surfaces de perte de quantification.
Atteint jusqu'à 6,3 % de gains en vision et 7,7 % en NLP.

items.title: Dynamic Token Merging for Efficient Vision-Language Models
items.summary: Dynamic Token Merging (DTM) is extended to vision-language models and decoder-only architectures as a general token deletion framework. Applying DTM to T5Gemma 2 and Gemma 3 reduces visual tokens and computational overhead while retaining high performance across multiple complex vision-language benchmarks.
keyPoints: Extends Dynamic Token Merging to vision and decoder-only models.
Reduces computational overhead while maintaining high benchmark accuracy.
Shows significant efficiency gains on document, chart, and text-reading tasks.

en.title: Dynamic Token Merging for Efficient Vision-Language Models
en.summary: Dynamic Token Merging (DTM) is extended to vision-language models and decoder-only architectures as a general token deletion framework. Applying DTM to T5Gemma 2 and Gemma 3 reduces visual tokens and computational overhead while retaining high performance across multiple complex vision-language benchmarks.
keyPoints: Extends Dynamic Token Merging to vision and decoder-only models.
Reduces computational overhead while maintaining high benchmark accuracy.
Shows significant efficiency gains on document, chart, and text-reading tasks.

fr.title: Fusion dynamique de jetons pour des modèles vision-langage efficaces
fr.summary: La fusion dynamique de jetons (DTM) est étendue aux modèles vision-langage et aux architectures à décodeur unique comme cadre général de suppression de jetons. Son application à T5Gemma 2 et Gemma 3 réduit les jetons visuels tout en préservant les performances sur de nombreux benchmarks.
keyPoints: Étend la fusion dynamique de jetons aux modèles visuels et de décodage.
Réduit la charge de calcul tout en maintenant une haute précision.
Montre des gains d'efficacité sur les tâches de lecture de graphiques et de documents.

items.title: Decision Models As General-Purpose Process Reward Models
items.summary: The authors introduce DM-PRM, a method that transforms general-purpose decision models into process reward models zero-shot, without requiring step labels, fine-tuning, or critics. Plugging into policy-gradient methods, DM-PRM significantly improves success rates on benchmarks like ALFWorld and WebShop compared to existing critic-based baselines.
keyPoints: Introduces DM-PRM to turn decision models into process reward models zero-shot.
Requires no step labels, fine-tuning, or learned critics.
Boosts GRPO and outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on ALFWorld and WebShop.

en.title: Decision Models As General-Purpose Process Reward Models
en.summary: The authors introduce DM-PRM, a method that transforms general-purpose decision models into process reward models zero-shot, without requiring step labels, fine-tuning, or critics. Plugging into policy-gradient methods, DM-PRM significantly improves success rates on benchmarks like ALFWorld and WebShop compared to existing critic-based baselines.
keyPoints: Introduces DM-PRM to turn decision models into process reward models zero-shot.

Boosts GRPO and outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on ALFWorld and WebShop.

fr.title: Les modèles de décision comme modèles de récompense de processus
fr.summary: Les auteurs présentent DM-PRM, une méthode qui transforme les modèles de décision généraux en modèles de récompense de processus sans étiquettes d'étape ni réglage fin. Intégré aux méthodes de gradient de politique, DM-PRM améliore nettement les taux de réussite sur ALFWorld et WebShop.
keyPoints: Introduit DM-PRM pour convertir des modèles de décision en zero-shot.
Ne nécessite aucune étiquette d'étape ni critique entraîné.
Améliore les performances sur ALFWorld et WebShop par rapport aux méthodes de référence.

items.title: Spatial Reasoning through Weight-Space Programming and LoRA
items.summary: Researchers evaluated weight-space programming and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) for spatial reasoning tasks using Qwen3.5-0.8B. While weight edits improved baseline performance modestly without harming other skills, supervised LoRA adaptation produced much larger target accuracy gains but caused interference and performance drops on neighboring tasks.
keyPoints: Compares weight-space programming with gradient-based LoRA adaptation.
Public weight patches provided moderate gains while preserving other skills.
Trained LoRA adapters achieved high target accuracy but caused cross-task interference.

en.title: Spatial Reasoning through Weight-Space Programming and LoRA
en.summary: Researchers evaluated weight-space programming and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) for spatial reasoning tasks using Qwen3.5-0.8B. While weight edits improved baseline performance modestly without harming other skills, supervised LoRA adaptation produced much larger target accuracy gains but caused interference and performance drops on neighboring tasks.
keyPoints: Compares weight-space programming with gradient-based LoRA adaptation.
Public weight patches provided moderate gains while preserving other skills.
Trained LoRA adapters achieved high target accuracy but caused cross-task interference.

fr.title: Raisonnement spatial par programmation dans l'espace des poids et LoRA
fr.summary: Les chercheurs ont évalué la programmation de l'espace des poids et l'adaptation LoRA pour des tâches de raisonnement spatial. Alors que les modifications de poids préservaient les compétences annexes, l'adaptation supervisée LoRA offrait de grands gains ciblés mais causait des interférences sur d'autres tâches.
keyPoints: Compare la programmation de l'espace des poids et l'adaptation LoRA.
Les correctifs de poids publics préservent les compétences voisines.
Les adaptateurs LoRA entraînés maximisent la précision cible mais créent des interférences.

items.title: Quantifying Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness and Efficiency in LLMs
items.summary: This paper operationalizes chain-of-thought (CoT) faithfulness and efficiency by representing reasoning as a semantic reasoning graph and decomposing predictive dependence. Findings reveal that answer-level unfaithfulness correlates with predictive uncertainty, and that accuracy and brevity alone provide incomplete assessments of reasoning quality.
keyPoints: Represents chain-of-thought as a semantic reasoning graph to measure metrics.
Shows unfaithfulness consistently associates with higher predictive uncertainty.
Demonstrates that accuracy and brevity offer incomplete evaluations of reasoning.

en.title: Quantifying Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness and Efficiency in LLMs
en.summary: This paper operationalizes chain-of-thought (CoT) faithfulness and efficiency by representing reasoning as a semantic reasoning graph and decomposing predictive dependence. Findings reveal that answer-level unfaithfulness correlates with predictive uncertainty, and that accuracy and brevity alone provide incomplete assessments of reasoning quality.
keyPoints: Represents chain-of-thought as a semantic reasoning graph to measure metrics.
Shows unfaithfulness consistently associates with higher predictive uncertainty.

fr.title: Quantification de la fidélité et de l'efficacité de la chaîne de pensée
fr.summary: Cet article formalise la fidélité et l'efficacité des chaînes de pensée en représentant le raisonnement sous forme de graphe sémantique. Les résultats montrent que le manque de fidélité est corrélé à l'incertitude prédictive, et que la précision seule ne suffit pas pour évaluer la qualité du raisonnement.
keyPoints: Représente la chaîne de pensée par un graphe de raisonnement sémantique.
Relie le manque de fidélité à une plus grande incertitude prédictive.
Indique que la précision et la concision ne suffisent pas pour évaluer le raisonnement.

items.title: CoEvoBench: Can LLMs Drive Recursive Co-Evolution of Agentic Systems?
items.summary: CoEvoBench evaluates LLMs as researchers co-evolving both the model and harness of target agents across five domains within a 24-hour budget. While frontier models successfully make initial improvements, results indicate they cannot yet autonomously translate feedback from an improved system into subsequent recursive iterations.
keyPoints: Introduces CoEvoBench to measure LLMs co-evolving agent models and harnesses.
Tests researchers over a 24-hour budget across five agentic domains.
Finds current LLMs make strong first improvements but struggle with recursive cycles.

en.title: CoEvoBench: Can LLMs Drive Recursive Co-Evolution of Agentic Systems?
en.summary: CoEvoBench evaluates LLMs as researchers co-evolving both the model and harness of target agents across five domains within a 24-hour budget. keyPoints: Introduces CoEvoBench to measure LLMs co-evolving agent models and harnesses.
Tests researchers over a 24-hour budget across five agentic domains.
Finds current LLMs make strong first improvements but struggle with recursive cycles.

fr.title: CoEvoBench : Les LLM peuvent-ils piloter la co-évolution des agents ?
fr.summary: CoEvoBench évalue les LLM en tant que chercheurs co-évoluant le modèle et le harnais d'agents cibles dans cinq domaines. Bien que les modèles de pointe réussissent de premières améliorations, ils ne parviennent pas encore à automatiser les itérations récursives suivantes.
keyPoints: Introduit CoEvoBench pour évaluer la co-évolution des modèles et harnais d'agents.
Teste les capacités de recherche sur un budget de 24 heures.
Montre que les LLM actuels peinent à enchaîner les cycles de co-évolution récursive.

items.title: Portable Active Recovery for Vision-Inertial Drones Under Outages
items.summary: Addressing position-dependent visual outages where standard hovering fails, researchers introduce a portable recovery module for quadrotors that requires zero retraining. Operating via telemetry alone, the module improves worst-condition completion rates significantly across a comprehensive 48-scene benchmark.
keyPoints: Introduces a portable active recovery module for position-dependent visual outages.
Attaches to host controllers with zero retraining and uses deployable telemetry.
Outperforms baseline methods on a 48-scene flight benchmark.

en.title: Portable Active Recovery for Vision-Inertial Drones Under Outages
en.summary: Addressing position-dependent visual outages where standard hovering fails, researchers introduce a portable recovery module for quadrotors that requires zero retraining. Operating via telemetry alone, the module improves worst-condition completion rates significantly across a comprehensive 48-scene benchmark.
keyPoints: Introduces a portable active recovery module for position-dependent visual outages.
Attaches to host controllers with zero retraining and uses deployable telemetry.
Outperforms baseline methods on a 48-scene flight benchmark.

fr.title: Récupération active portable pour drones face aux pannes visuelles
fr.summary: Face aux pannes visuelles dépendantes de la position où le vol stationnaire échoue, les chercheurs présentent un module de récupération portable pour quadricoptères sans réentraînement. Utilisant uniquement la télémétrie, le module améliore nettement les taux de réussite en conditions difficiles.
keyPoints: Propose un module de récupération active pour pannes visuelles positionnelles.
S'intègre sans réentraînement et exploite les données de télémétrie.
Surpasse les méthodes de référence sur un benchmark de vol à 48 scènes.

items.title: Understanding Learning Dynamics of On-Policy Distillation Failures
items.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) can suffer from training instability, response length explosion, and spurious agreement. This paper investigates these dynamics by tracing failure mechanisms, showing how mismatched states disrupt learning and steer students toward unreliable states.
keyPoints: Investigates instabilities and failures in on-policy distillation (OPD).
Traces learning dynamics and analyzes mismatched student-teacher states.
Explains how training on mismatched states leads to repetitive generations.

en.title: Understanding Learning Dynamics of On-Policy Distillation Failures
en.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) can suffer from training instability, response length explosion, and spurious agreement. This paper investigates these dynamics by tracing failure mechanisms, showing how mismatched states disrupt learning and steer students toward unreliable states.
keyPoints: Investigates instabilities and failures in on-policy distillation (OPD).
Traces learning dynamics and analyzes mismatched student-teacher states.
Explains how training on mismatched states leads to repetitive generations.

fr.title: Dynamique d'apprentissage et échecs de la distillation en politique
fr.summary: La distillation en politique (OPD) peut souffrir d'instabilités d'entraînement et d'accords fallacieux. Cet article étudie ces dynamiques en retraçant les mécanismes d'échec, démontrant comment les états inadaptés perturbent l'apprentissage et poussent le modèle vers des comportements répétitifs.
keyPoints: Étudie les instabilités de la distillation en politique (OPD).
Analyse les états mal assortis entre l'étudiant et l'enseignant.
Explique comment ces écarts mènent à des générations répétitives.

items.title: MAPES: Multi-Value Alignment Pipeline via Expert Specialization
items.summary: MAPES is a multi-value alignment paradigm designed to handle competing human values in LLMs by treating conflict resolution as a core concern. It decomposes supervision into value-specific experts in isolated subspaces and recomposes them via preference-aware merging and harmonization, outperforming standard baseline methods.
keyPoints: Proposes MAPES to resolve competing human values during LLM alignment.
Decomposes supervision into value-specific experts in isolated subspaces.
Recomposes models using preference-aware merging and harmonization stages.

en.title: MAPES: Multi-Value Alignment Pipeline via Expert Specialization
en.summary: MAPES is a multi-value alignment paradigm designed to handle competing human values in LLMs by treating conflict resolution as a core concern. It decomposes supervision into value-specific experts in isolated subspaces and recomposes them via preference-aware merging and harmonization, outperforming standard baseline methods.
keyPoints: Proposes MAPES to resolve competing human values during LLM alignment.
Decomposes supervision into value-specific experts in isolated subspaces.
Recomposes models using preference-aware merging and harmonization stages.

fr.title: MAPES : Pipeline d'alignement multi-valeurs par spécialisation d'experts
fr.summary: MAPES est un paradigme d'alignement multi-valeurs conçu pour gérer des valeurs humaines concurrentes dans les LLM. Il décompose la supervision en experts spécialisés dans des sous-espaces isolés puis les recompose via une fusion et une harmonisation conscientes des préférences.
keyPoints: Propose MAPES pour résoudre les conflits de valeurs lors de l'alignement.
Décompose la supervision en experts spécifiques dans des sous-espaces.
Recompose les modèles via une fusion et une harmonisation adaptées.

items.title: Analyzing Double Counting in LLM Evidence Fusion
items.summary: Language models fusing reports from shared sources can suffer from evidence double counting. Researchers build a graded-dependence exact reference framework to evaluate model rule compliance and posterior gains, testing various receiver configurations across thousands of synthetic worlds.
keyPoints: Examines evidence double counting in LLM retrieval and agent consensus.
Builds a graded-dependence exact reference to price rules and measure risk.
Evaluates multiple model configurations across thousands of test scenarios.

en.title: Analyzing Double Counting in LLM Evidence Fusion
en.summary: Language models fusing reports from shared sources can suffer from evidence double counting. Researchers build a graded-dependence exact reference framework to evaluate model rule compliance and posterior gains, testing various receiver configurations across thousands of synthetic worlds.
keyPoints: Examines evidence double counting in LLM retrieval and agent consensus.
Builds a graded-dependence exact reference to price rules and measure risk.
Evaluates multiple model configurations across thousands of test scenarios.

fr.title: Analyse du double comptage dans la fusion de preuves par les LLM
fr.summary: Les grands modèles de langage fusionnant des rapports issus de sources partagées risquent de compter double les preuves. Les chercheurs construient un cadre de référence exact à dépendance graduée pour évaluer la conformité des règles et les gains a posteriori des modèles.
keyPoints: Examine le double comptage de preuves dans le consensus des agents LLM.
Construit un cadre de référence exact pour évaluer les risques.
Évalue plusieurs configurations de modèles sur des milliers de scénarios.

items.title: How AI Team Size and Formation Shape Brainstorming
items.summary: Researchers studied human-AI brainstorming teams with 168 participants, crossing AI partnership sizes (one vs. two) with behavioral formations (average human behavior vs. customized). Two-AI rooms posted more ideas to the shared board, but human-authored ideas dropped substantially. With one AI partner, an average-calibrated AI led to the highest posting volume, an effect that vanished with two AIs.
keyPoints: Tested AI partnership size and formation in a brainstorming experiment with 168 participants.
Two-AI rooms increased total board posts but substantially reduced human-authored ideas.
Single-agent results did not generalize to multi-agent teams.

en.title: How AI Team Size and Formation Shape Brainstorming
en.summary: Researchers studied human-AI brainstorming teams with 168 participants, crossing AI partnership sizes (one vs. two) with behavioral formations (average human behavior vs. customized). Two-AI rooms posted more ideas to the shared board, but human-authored ideas dropped substantially. With one AI partner, an average-calibrated AI led to the highest posting volume, an effect that vanished with two AIs.
keyPoints: Tested AI partnership size and formation in a brainstorming experiment with 168 participants.
Two-AI rooms increased total board posts but substantially reduced human-authored ideas.
Single-agent results did not generalize to multi-agent teams.

fr.title: Impact de la taille et de la formation des équipes d'IA
fr.summary: Des chercheurs ont étudie des équipes de brainstorming humain-IA avec 168 participants, en croisant la taille du partenariat (un contre deux) et la formation comportementale. Les salles à deux IA ont publié plus d'idées, mais les contributions humaines ont chuté. Avec une seule IA, la formation calibrée sur la moyenne humaine a maximisé les publications.
keyPoints: Expérience menée sur le brainstorming avec 168 participants et différentes configurations d'IA.
Les salles à deux IA augmentent les publications globales mais réduisent les idées humaines.
Les résultats obtenus avec un seul agent ne se généralisent pas aux équipes multi-agents.

items.title: Synthesizing CTI Knowledge Graphs via Generation by Simulation
items.summary: The authors study an alternative paradigm for synthesizing relational training data like knowledge graphs using language models: generation by simulation. Instead of describing an artifact directly, an agent proposes intent and a deterministic referee resolves outcomes against an explicit world model. They instantiate this for cyber threat intelligence knowledge graphs and prove referential closure, causal grounding, and identifier stability.
keyPoints: Introduces generation by simulation to make coherence a property of construction for knowledge graphs.
Instantiated for STIX 2.1 cyber threat intelligence knowledge graphs using three engines.
Proves mathematical guarantees including referential closure and causal grounding.

en.title: Synthesizing CTI Knowledge Graphs via Generation by Simulation
en.summary: The authors study an alternative paradigm for synthesizing relational training data like knowledge graphs using language models: generation by simulation. Instead of describing an artifact directly, an agent proposes intent and a deterministic referee resolves outcomes against an explicit world model. keyPoints: Introduces generation by simulation to make coherence a property of construction for knowledge graphs.
Instantiated for STIX 2.1 cyber threat intelligence knowledge graphs using three engines.
Proves mathematical guarantees including referential closure and causal grounding.

fr.title: Synthèse de graphes de connaissances CTI par simulation
fr.summary: Les auteurs étudient un paradigme alternatif pour synthétiser des données relationnelles par IA : la génération par simulation. Plutôt que de décrire directement un artefact, un agent propose une intention et un arbitre déterministe résout les résultats. Cette approche est appliquée aux graphes de connaissances en cybermenaces.
keyPoints: Introduit la génération par simulation pour garantir la cohérence par la construction.
Appliqué aux graphes de renseignement sur les cybermenaces au format STIX 2.1.
Démontre des garanties mathématiques incluant la fermeture référentielle et l'ancrage causal.

items.title: TOUMAII: A 4.5M-Pair Tool-Calling Preference Dataset
items.summary: To address the scarcity of realistic preference data for tool-calling agents, the authors introduce TOUMAII, a large-scale tool-calling preference dataset containing approximately 4.5 million validated preference pairs. They also release TOUMAII-Gen, a synthetic data generation pipeline that produces preference datasets with natural model-generated tool-calling failure modes.
keyPoints: Releases TOUMAII, featuring ~4.5M validated preference pairs for tool-calling.
Includes TOUMAII-Gen, a synthetic pipeline producing data with natural failure modes.
Demonstrates performance parity when fine-tuning a 3-billion-parameter model.

en.title: TOUMAII: A 4.5M-Pair Tool-Calling Preference Dataset
en.summary: To address the scarcity of realistic preference data for tool-calling agents, the authors introduce TOUMAII, a large-scale tool-calling preference dataset containing approximately 4.5 million validated preference pairs. They also release TOUMAII-Gen, a synthetic data generation pipeline that produces preference datasets with natural model-generated tool-calling failure modes.
keyPoints: Releases TOUMAII, featuring ~4.5M validated preference pairs for tool-calling.
Includes TOUMAII-Gen, a synthetic pipeline producing data with natural failure modes.
Demonstrates performance parity when fine-tuning a 3-billion-parameter model.

fr.title: TOUMAII : Un jeu de données de préférence d'appel d'outils
fr.summary: Pour pallier le manque de données de préférence pour les agents d'appel d'outils, les auteurs présentent TOUMAII, un jeu de données contenant environ 4,5 millions de paires validées. Ils publient également TOUMAII-Gen, un pipeline de génération synthétique intégrant des modes d'échec naturels.
keyPoints: Publication de TOUMAII avec environ 4,5 millions de paires de préférences validées.
Intègre TOUMAII-Gen, un pipeline synthétique pour les modes d'échec d'appel d'outils.
Permet d'atteindre des performances équivalentes sur un modèle de 3 milliards de paramètres.

items.title: ChatAtom: Multi-Agent LLM System for Molecular Dynamics
items.summary: ChatAtom is a multi-agent large language model system designed to translate natural-language requests into complete molecular dynamics (MD) simulation workflows without requiring manual script writing. It coordinates specialized agents for orchestration, script generation, high-performance computing dispatch, and analysis via an interactive browser interface.
keyPoints: Translates natural language requests into complete molecular dynamics simulation workflows.
Employs specialized agents with generator-reviewer pairs for scripting and visualization.
Features a browser interface streaming thermodynamic data and rendered simulation frames.

en.title: ChatAtom: Multi-Agent LLM System for Molecular Dynamics

keyPoints: Translates natural language requests into complete molecular dynamics simulation workflows.

fr.title: ChatAtom : Système multi-agent LLM pour la dynamique moléculaire
fr.summary: ChatAtom est un système LLM multi-agent qui traduit des requêtes en langage naturel en flux de simulation de dynamique moléculaire complets, sans écriture manuelle de scripts. Il coordonne des agents spécialisés pour l'orchestration, la génération de scripts et l'analyse via une interface de navigateur.

Utilise des agents spécialisés avec des paires générateur-réviseur pour les scripts.
Intègre une interface de navigateur affichant les données thermodynamiques en temps réel.

items.title: HERMES: Interpretable Tumor Immune Microenvironment Reasoning
items.summary: The authors present HERMES (H&E-mIF Reasoning with Multimodal Evidence Supervision), an R1-style multimodal large language model that reasons jointly over paired H&E and mIF images. Trained with a process reward checking every stated quantity against cell-level ground truth, the 4B model achieves an average accuracy of 84.5% across four colorectal cancer TIME tasks.
